description.zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的**实例概览**页面，查看当前实例的**ID**。

><notice>
- 若有ID值，必须传入该**ID**值，否则调用会失败。
- 若无**实例概览**页面或**ID**值，则无需传入。

></notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见[实例概述](~~356505~~)。
description.en:
The instance ID. You can view the **ID** of your current instance on the **Instance Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.

><notice>
- If an ID exists, you must specify this **ID**; otherwise, the API call will fail.
- If the **Instance Overview** page or the **ID** is not available, this parameter is not required.

></notice>

For more information about instances, see [Instance Overview](~~356505~~).

description.zh:
设备任务ID。任务的全局唯一标识符。

您可在物联网平台控制台的**设备管理 > 任务**页面，查看任务ID。
description.en:
The device task ID. This is the globally unique identifier of the task.

You can view the task ID on the **Devices > Jobs** page in the IoT Platform console.

descriptions.zh:
## 使用说明
仅支持指定已完成或已超时状态的设备任务。

已完成状态设备任务，表示该任务下所有作业已执行完成。已执行完成作业状态如下：

- **FAILED**：已失败。
- **REJECTED**：已拒绝。
- **TIMED_OUT**：已超时。
- **SUCCEEDED**：已成功。
- **CANCELLED**：已取消。

> 若设备任务下所有作业执行状态为已成功，调用本接口无法重新执行设备任务。

## QPS限制
单个阿里云账号调用该接口的每秒请求数（QPS）最大限制为5。
> RAM用户共享阿里云账号配额。
descriptions.en:
## How-To  
This operation supports only device tasks that are in the **Completed** or **Timed Out** status.

A device task in the **Completed** status indicates that all jobs under the task have finished execution. The possible final statuses of a completed job are as follows:

- **FAILED**: The job failed.
- **REJECTED**: The job was denied.
- **TIMED_OUT**: The job timed out.
- **SUCCEEDED**: The job succeeded.
- **CANCELLED**: The job was canceled.

> If all jobs under a device task have succeeded, calling this API will not re-execute the task.

## QPS Limit  
Each Alibaba Cloud account can send a maximum of 5 queries per second (QPS) to call this API.  
> Resource Access Management (RAM) users share the quota of the Alibaba Cloud account.
